_comment: Amplification factor applied to planet's trait contribution when involved in each aspect type. Harmonious aspects (trine, sextile) boost positively; challenging aspects (square, opposition) also amplify but add turbulence. Quincunx is weak/awkward. Factor is applied as (1 + weight * orb_tightness) multiplier on the planet contribution; i.e., a tight conjunction ~1.25x, a wide sextile ~1.05x.
_planet_weights_comment: Relative influence of each planet on final trait computation. Luminaries dominate personality; outer planets contribute generational flavor.
